label: Hattush

text.BHSA NEH 12:1: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָל֛וּ עִם־זְרֻבָּבֶ֥ל בֶּן־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵ֖ל וְיֵשׁ֑וּעַ שְׂרָיָ֥ה יִרְמְיָ֖ה עֶזְרָֽא׃
text.KJV NEH 12:1: Now these are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

A.name: Hattush
A.notes: named on the sealed document of NEH 10:1-27 (NEH 10:4)
family: descendant-of aaron (Aaron, brother of Moses (EXO 4:14) and Levitical priest (EXO 28:1))

B.name: Hattush
family: descendant-of david (David, son of Jesse (RUT 4:17), King of Israel (2SA 5:3))

why: חַטּוּשׁ occurs in the list introduced in Nehemiah 12:1 as priests and Levites who returned with Zerubbabel and Jeshua, matching A’s Aaronic priesthood. B is a Judahite descendant of David who returned with Ezra, a different return.
